description: This file defines the class HiveSessionImplwithUGI, which extends HiveSessionImpl to manage user sessions with UserGroupInformation (UGI) and delegation tokens, including setup, cleanup, and delegation token handling.

classes.name: HiveSessionImplwithUGI
classes.description: A subclass of HiveSessionImpl that manages user sessions with UGI and delegation tokens, providing methods for session setup, cleanup, and token management.

methods.name: HiveSessionImplwithUGI
methods.description: Constructor initializing session with protocol, username, password, configuration, IP address, and delegation token.

methods.name: setSessionUGI
methods.description: Sets up the UserGroupInformation (UGI) for the session based on the owner username.

methods.name: getSessionUgi
methods.description: Returns the UserGroupInformation object for the session.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, cancels delegation token, and cleans up file system handles.

methods.name: setDelegationToken
methods.description: Enables delegation token for the session, setting token signature and storing token string.

methods.name: cancelDelegationToken
methods.description: Cancels the delegation token and closes the metastore connection.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the proxy session associated with this session.

methods.name: getDelegationToken
methods.description: Obtains a delegation token via the auth factory.

methods.name: cancelDelegationToken
methods.description: Cancels a delegation token via the auth factory.

methods.name: renewDelegationToken
methods.description: Renews a delegation token via the auth factory.
